title: Synpulse carries Flowable without a Camunda partnership, unlike most of the cohort
content:
Synpulse is a Zurich management consultancy serving banks and insurers, and the record singles out one structural fact: it is Flowable-exclusive, not a Camunda partner. In a sweep where dual certification is common — adesso, XTi, ELCA, GFT and Onepoint all hold both — exclusivity is the exception worth recording.

Single-platform commitment changes the conversation in a concrete way. A dual-certified firm has two vendor relationships to protect and will weigh any new layer against both alliance frameworks. An exclusive partner has one orchestration story, so a component that strengthens that story has no competing internal claim on it, and the firm's own positioning improves when the platform's weakest point is covered.

The qualifier is the firm's category: management consultancy. Like Eraneos in the same sweep, its deliverable is advice and programme design rather than running software, so it may recommend and specify a record layer without being the party that builds and operates it. That is a question to settle before a pitch, and it is why the row sits at priority 3 despite the clean platform position. Provenance: Flowable Partner Finder, mined 2026-08-18, not imprint-swept.
